_about: William Martin Leake (1777-1860): The Topography of Athens and the Demi, second edition, 2 vols. (London: printed for the author, sold by J. Rodwell, 1841), raw IA OCR. Also Travels in Northern Greece, 4 vols. (J. Rodwell, 1835; vol. I's year reads '1885' in the OCR, a misreading of the 1835 set), and Travels in the Morea, vols. I and III (John Murray, MDCCCXXX); Morea vol. II is wanted (IA unavailable this round). Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics). No uids minted.
